2024 Arab Summit and bilateral strategy

In May 2024, MBS hosted the [[arab-summit-2024-bahrain|33rd Arab Summit]] in Bahrain, with UN Secretary-General [[antonio-guterres|António Guterres]] attending as special guest of honor, and the gathering issued a joint statement demanding a permanent Israeli withdrawal from Palestine.[{n}] Badlands contributor [[ghostofbasedpatrickhenry|GhostofBasedPatrickHenry]] argued that the Saudis had spent years courting players across the geopolitical board through bilateral agreements — 'an art long lost to the globalists' — building a network of relationships that could now be leveraged to turn globalist institutions against the globalists themselves, concluding that MBS had 'made himself the new gamemaster.'[{n}]
antonio-guterres
33rd Arab Summit (2024)

Guterres attended the [[arab-summit-2024-bahrain|33rd Arab Summit]] in Bahrain in May 2024 as a special guest of honor, at a gathering hosted with Saudi Crown Prince [[mohammed-bin-salman|Mohammed bin Salman]] that issued a joint statement demanding Israel permanently withdraw the [[israel-defense-forces|IDF]] from Palestine and calling on the international community to act.[{n}]

May 2024: South Africa's Gaza genocide arguments

In mid-May 2024, the ICJ convened to hear South Africa's new arguments alleging Israeli genocide in Gaza.[{n}] Badlands contributor [[ghostofbasedpatrickhenry|GhostofBasedPatrickHenry]] highlighted that the hearing fell on the same day as the [[arab-summit-2024-bahrain|33rd Arab Summit]] in Bahrain, arguing the convergence was no coincidence but evidence of coordinated pressure on Israel by a Saudi-built network of bilateral partners.[{n}]

May 2024: liquidation of the Northeast Gasoline Supply Reserve

In May 2024, with Biden trailing [[donald-trump|Donald Trump]] by double digits, his administration announced it would sell the nearly one million barrels held in the [[northeast-gasoline-supply-reserve|Northeast Gasoline Supply Reserve]], effectively closing the facility.[{n}] The authority to do so had been buried in the roughly 1,050-page, $1.7 trillion discretionary spending bill passed in March 2024 to avert a government shutdown and signed by Biden two months earlier.[{n}] The move followed his earlier drawdown of about half of the [[strategic-petroleum-reserve|Strategic Petroleum Reserve]] ahead of the 2022 midterm elections, and [[zerohedge|ZeroHedge]] described the closure as leaving the continental Northeast defenseless against a genuine supply shock or environmental catastrophe.[{n}]
strategic-petroleum-reserve
2024 drawdowns and the Northeast gasoline stockpile

By 2024, [[joe-biden|Joe Biden]] had drained roughly half of the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, a step [[zerohedge|ZeroHedge]] attributed to avoiding Democratic losses in the 2022 midterm elections.[{n}] In May 2024 the administration went further, announcing the sale of the nearly one million barrels in the separate [[northeast-gasoline-supply-reserve|Northeast Gasoline Supply Reserve]] and effectively closing it.[{n}] Badlands contributor [[burning-bright|Burning Bright]] noted that [[donald-trump|Donald Trump]] had topped the reserves up while in office, and framed the drawdowns as trading long-term energy and national-security stability for a publicized few cents per gallon.[{n}]
department-of-energy
Closure of the Northeast Gasoline Supply Reserve (2024)

In May 2024 the Department of Energy announced the sale of the nearly one million barrels of gasoline held in the U.S.-managed stockpile in northeastern states, effectively closing the [[northeast-gasoline-supply-reserve|Northeast Gasoline Supply Reserve]].[{n}] The step followed a provision in the March 2024 government funding bill authorizing the sell-off and shuttering of the reserve.[{n}]

Reporting on the Northeast gasoline reserve (2024)

In March 2024, while reading the roughly 1,050-page bill meant to avert a government shutdown — which authorized some $1.7 trillion in discretionary spending — ZeroHedge identified a provision selling off and shuttering the [[northeast-gasoline-supply-reserve|Northeast Gasoline Supply Reserve]], and wondered aloud whether the text had been inserted for the benefit of America's enemies.[{n}] Two months later, when the [[joe-biden|Biden]] administration announced the sale, the outlet noted it had been wrong to assume nobody would pursue such short-term gains at the expense of the nation's long-term security.[{n}] ZeroHedge also reported on the widening Slovak investigation into a broader conspiracy behind the assassination attempt on [[robert-fico|Robert Fico]], noting it was the first such attack on a European head of state in 20 years.[{n}]
